description: The Department for Housing and Urban Development publishes GIS areas where the provider identifies special corrosion protection requirements for Class 1a and 10a buildings. The described areas lie within one kilometre of the coastline or ten kilometres of breaking surf. The record links these areas to the Building Code of Australia. The spatial zones provide a defined building-exposure constraint for simulation; they do not provide corrosion rates or structural fragility curves. The regional data are listed on Data.SA in GeoJSON, Shapefile and compressed KML formats, with public access under CC BY 4.0. Catalogue metadata and download headers were checked; files were not opened. Spatial resolution, attribute definitions and the currency of the underlying observations remain unverified. The related Data.SA catalogue record provides the discovery context.
